purpose: Bounded public development-case discovery of ordinary positive native ETH transfers; not a benchmark.
selection: One latest full block scan; first three transactions in list order with recipient, input0x, positive value and distinct from/to. Verify code-free sender and recipient at common parent hash. Execute identical from/to/input/value with gas5000000; no state or block overrides. Require isolated native value changes and sender nonce+1 from complete diff versus pinned before balances, then original receipt/trace and full source/parent canonical rechecks. Stop first success; retain failures and unattempted planned candidates. Budget exhaustion does not authorize a retry.
